design.objective: Add an authenticated Chinese change-password flow from the top-right user menu.

requirements.statement: User identity control opens a dropdown with change password and logout actions.
acceptance: Both header variants expose the same actions

requirements.statement: Change-password form validates old password, new password, confirmation, and length.
acceptance: Chinese field errors and submit loading are visible

requirements.statement: Backend verifies the authenticated account's old BCrypt hash and writes a new BCrypt hash with tenant scope.
acceptance: Wrong old password is rejected and valid password is persisted
counterexample: Client-supplied user id changes another account

requirements.statement: Successful change clears the current browser session and returns to login.
acceptance: Access and refresh tokens are removed and login route is shown
counterexample: User remains in the authenticated shell

requirements.statement: Existing workflow pagination changes remain intact and builds pass.
acceptance: Security Maven test, frontend build, and diff check pass

selected_approach.name: security endpoint plus shell dialog
selected_approach.reason: Reuses existing AuthService, repository, Pinia store, and Element Plus shell patterns

data_flows: dialog -> store -> authenticated endpoint -> BCrypt verify/update -> clear session -> login

security: server owns identity and hash verification

assumptions: current local backend is source-built or can be rebuilt
unknowns: browser session may need manual refresh after source rebuild
decisions: frontend clears session after success because JWT access tokens are stateless
risks: other devices retain valid access tokens until expiry; this is explicitly outside scope

approval.evidence: User confirmed implementation after prior design discussion

tasks.goal: Implement authenticated BCrypt password change endpoint
input_facts: existing AuthUser contains id, tenant, and hash

steps.action: Verify old hash and update tenant-scoped hash
steps.expected: Wrong old password fails; valid request updates hash

acceptance_checks: wrong old password does not update
risks: stateless access tokens on other devices remain valid
escalation_conditions: repository contract conflicts with current schema

tasks.goal: Expose change password from both shell user controls
input_facts: AppLayout has two direct logout controls

steps.action: Add store method and dialog state
Replace both header logout buttons with dropdown actions

acceptance_checks: success clears tokens and routes login

tasks.goal: Run module, frontend, diff, and browser verification
input_facts: existing workflow files are dirty and must remain

steps.command: mvn -pl :ccb-security -am test; npm --prefix web run build; git diff --check
steps.expected: exit code 0 or documented environment blocker

steps.action: Smoke test user dropdown and dialog
steps.expected: desktop/mobile controls render without console errors

risks: local backend may run stale package
tasks.rollback: retain source changes and document stale runtime
stop_conditions: security test or build failure unresolved
escalation_conditions: runtime requires user credentials or external service

assumptions.text: The existing sys_user table is available with password_hash
